construction: All dense representatives were jointly relaxed under a 32-element coordinate-sign subgroup, with the actual 3,424 middle-support constraints and their projected sign parity. The 441,244-point sparse configuration is unchanged.
coordinates: Exact normalized integer directions at scale 100,000,000; floating search output is not trusted by either proof.
search: SciPy L-BFGS-B with analytically differentiated angle penalties. Search constraint lists were pruned for speed, but complete dense pairs and every actual support were checked after optimization; final integer verification is exhaustive.
